name: muse
description: eta-mu muse workspace. Runtime deps for tests and the mongo ledger boundary; plugin/daemon bundles carry their own package.json.

scripts.build: shadow-cljs release daemon opencode-plugin mcp-server claude-server && node .claude/dist/claude-server.js --emit-hook-config
scripts.build:opencode: npm run prebuild && shadow-cljs release opencode-plugin
scripts.build:mcp: npm run prebuild && shadow-cljs release mcp-server
